illustrations.alt: Un robot ambré de salle serveur, entouré de dossiers, de bandes perforées et d'horloges, dans un halo de lumière
illustrations.consigne: Subject: a friendly "machine-creature of the server room" that embodies "FTP" (enterprise integration, Fichiers & Batch). What it means (French, for context only): « Transfert de fichiers en clair. Officiellement interdit chez Elis. Officieusement… ». Visual motifs: folders, punched tapes, clocks. Rarity: strong glowing halo, sparkling particles and light rays, legendary. Digital illustration for a collectible card game, landscape 4:3, light isometric view, one single central subject readable at small size, clean bold shapes, soft cel shading, dark navy blue background with a subtle amber glow, limited palette dominated by amber and burnt orange. Strictly no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no watermark, no real people.

Un robot magenta relié à une constellation de points lumineux, comme des synapses, dans un halo éclatant
illustrations.consigne: Subject: an upgraded, more spectacular "machine-creature of the server room" that embodies "Solace Agent Mesh" (enterprise integration, IA agentique). It is the evolution of "Solace Event Mesh": keep its silhouette, upgraded. What it means (French, for context only): « Les agents d’IA branchés sur l’event mesh, qui dialoguent en A2A et utilisent MCP. ». Visual motifs: constellations, glowing eyes, synapses. Rarity: strong glowing halo, sparkling particles and light rays, legendary. Digital illustration for a collectible card game, landscape 4:3, light isometric view, one single central subject readable at small size, clean bold shapes, soft cel shading, dark navy blue background with a subtle magenta glow, limited palette dominated by magenta and purple. Strictly no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no watermark, no real people.
